description: Horaires théoriques du réseau Moova - Communauté d'Agglomération de Vesoul (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Réseau moova - Communauté d'Agglomération de Vesoul. List of stops, schedules, and routes of the Moova network circulating on the territory of the Agglomeration Community of Vesoul in GTFS format. Coverage: Réseau moova - Communauté d'Agglomération de Vesoul. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical schedules of the Moova network - Agglomeration Community of Vesoul (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Réseau moova - Communauté d'Agglomération de Vesoul. Its keywords include gtfs, vesoul, moova, vbus. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS, GTFS-RT. The listing shows 2026-06-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
